Reloaded the dashboard at the plain URL http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfyx4cnymfq4gf/fwgr63-n2-bench-dashboard and the auto-refresh interval persisted as '1m': the toolbar refresh button reads "1m" with aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected", and Grafana itself re-added &refresh=1m to the address bar. Because the time picker in this Grafana version has no 'Refresh interval' section (its dialog contains only Quick ranges, Absolute time range and 'Change time settings'), I set the interval via the toolbar refresh-interval button ("Auto refresh turned off. Choose refresh time interval") and chose 1m, then entered edit mode and used 'Save dashboard'. The save dialog did not offer 'Update default time range'; it offered 'Update default refresh value' (which was unticked), so I ticked that and confirmed Save → "Dashboard saved". The time range remains 'Last 6 hours' and both panels ('fwgr63-n2 Notes', 'fwgr63-n2 Availability') are still present.
